summary.plain: The engineering blueprint for KM3NeT: how the deep-sea neutrino telescope infrastructure in the Mediterranean was designed to be built, published in 2010 after a design study that ran from 2006.
summary.technical: KM3NeT Technical Design Report for a Deep-Sea Research Infrastructure in the Mediterranean Sea Incorporating a Very Large Volume Neutrino Telescope, published March 2010 following the 2008 Conceptual Design Report and the EU-funded KM3NeT Design Study (February 2006 - December 2009).
